items.author: Motley Fool Transcribing
items.highlights: Management reported that AI demand has reached an inflection point, with revenue growth driven by a global buildout of compute infrastructure. The company stated that it expects supply to remain a bottleneck through fiscal 2028, leading to a constrained revenue outlook despite demand exceeding supply. NVIDIA is evolving from a component supplier to a full-stack platform provider, capturing higher capital value per gigawatt of data center capacity. Management noted that the expansion of sovereign AI and specialized cloud providers now balances the contribution from traditional hyperscalers. ..
